g.text: Reply lag: word n carries the reply to word n-2 (simulated, tb/top_tb.sv). The tile needs 67 clocks, so the host sends two NOPs before STATUS.

g.text: Board only: TDI reaches the bridge 7 TCK after the TDO framing (found by sweeping all 64 offsets; same at 6, 16 and 24 MHz). pack_scan shifts every scan 7 bits earlier. Simulation does not model it.
